observations: Only cat.taste.d changed for zh; cat.taste.t (哈萨美食) already matches term 125 after nav-four. Item 1 (footer) is code-only; item 2 is German-only.

Termbase 130/131 carry Latin glosses 哈里斯（Harees）/穆法拉格（Mufallaq） for body first mention, and TM dining.faq1.a glosses 哈里斯（Harees）; the card follows the food page name fields instead (no glosses), per the brief. A blind reader may not recognise 哈里斯/穆法拉格 as dishes without the gloss; the 家常美味 head noun and the card link to the food page carry that.
ui.ts is CRLF; the edit is a single-line in-place string replacement (U+0020 indentation unchanged). Stage 6 judge (>=90) still pending before publish.
